Job Description:
   
About our cybersecurity team
Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world's leading technology companies? HPE's Cybersecurity team protects the people, systems, and information that enable our business. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with deep Security Service Edge expertise to strengthen and scale secure access for users and applications. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, building durable capabilities, and improving how security services operate globally, we would like to hear from you.

About the role
As a Network Security Engineer - Security Service Edge at HPE, you will engineer, improve, and scale enterprise Zero Trust access capabilities across Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). You will apply advanced knowledge of SSE/SASE architecture, secure web gateway controls, identity integration, and enterprise authentication to improve service resilience and user experience.
You will work across cybersecurity, endpoint, network, identity, and support teams to resolve complex issues spanning traffic forwarding, authentication, policy enforcement, SSL inspection, DNS, and private application connectivity. Using platform logs, endpoint data, network traces, and packet captures, you will turn operational insight into repeatable designs, standards, automation, and preventive improvements. This hands-on individual contributor role calls for significant independent judgment, cross-functional partnership, and technical leadership.

About you
You bring advanced knowledge of Security Service Edge, Zero Trust, enterprise networking, identity, endpoint integration, and controls such as URL filtering, firewall policy, DNS security, sandboxing, and data loss prevention. You are comfortable moving from ambiguous problems to practical designs, isolating root causes from multiple sources of evidence, and implementing improvements that remain effective after the immediate issue is resolved.
You combine deep technical troubleshooting with a builder mindset. You identify gaps rather than waiting for tasks, define scalable standards and patterns, and measure impact through improved reliability, reduced recurring incidents, stronger security controls, and a better user experience. You communicate clearly across global technical and support teams, document engineering decisions and operating practices effectively, and enjoy helping engineers and support teams work through complex incidents, technical choices, and new ways of working.

You will be responsible for
Engineering and continuously improving enterprise Security Service Edge capabilities across ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX to advance Zero Trust access outcomes.
Designing and evolving scalable policy frameworks, ZPA application segmentation models, and access controls that balance security, reliability, and user experience.
Leading the technical resolution of complex internet access, private application access, authentication, traffic-forwarding, policy-enforcement, and performance issues.

title: Product Support Engineer III - ZTB (SDWAN)
text:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role

We are looking for an Product Support Engineer III to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Customer Support. The Product Support Engineer III will provide world-class post-sales technical support to internal Level I & Level II Support Engineers, as well as provide direct support to customers and partners on escalated issues. 

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Engage with customers on escalated support issues or critical customer situations and participate in a 24x7 Support Operation and 24x7 on-call rotation

Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting

Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams

Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base

Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

6+ years of experience as a Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products

Practical knowledge of networking and security products and enterprise network infrastructure

Experience troubleshooting network issues and familiarity with necessary tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and MTR

Roles & Responsibilities :
Shape the future of data-driven reporting and decision-making

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com 

 

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
Engineer – Development, Indexing (C++ / SQL)

Experience: 0–2 years; Fresh graduates are welcome
Location: Bangalore

 The Opportunity

We are looking for an Engineer to join our Indexing team. You will contribute to software that organizes and retrieves data efficiently, with a focus on correctness, performance, and reliability. You will also develop automation to improve testing, validation, and engineering workflows.

This role is suited to an early-career developer with strong C++ and SQL skills, a systematic approach to development, and the curiosity to ask what could go wrong and how to test it.

What you’ll do

Develop and maintain indexing components using C++ and SQL.

Build and maintain automated tests, validation scripts, and tools that reduce repetitive work.

Investigate defects by reproducing issues, examining logs, stepping through code, and identifying root causes.

Write SQL queries to retrieve, validate, and troubleshoot data.

Design test cases covering expected behaviour, boundary conditions, invalid inputs, and failure scenarios.

Add unit and regression tests to validate changes and prevent recurring defects.

Work with developers and QA engineers to clarify requirements, review changes, and resolve issues.

Communicate findings, explain technical decisions, and document your work clearly.

Who you are

A fresh graduate or developer with up to two years of software development experience. Relevant academic projects and internships are welcome.

Proficient in C++, including object-oriented programming, STL containers, pointers, references, and memory management.

Comfortable writing SQL queries using joins, aggregations, and subqueries, with an understanding of relational database fundamentals.

Strong in data structures, algorithms, and logical problem-solving.

Able to debug methodically, test assumptions, and explain how you arrived at a solution.

Able to translate a requirement into varied test scenarios, including empty or duplicate data, boundary values, large inputs, and interrupted operations.

Interested in automation and identifying opportunities to improve testing and development efficiency.

Clear in written and verbal communication, willing to ask questions, and receptive to feedback.

Curious about unfamiliar code and motivated to learn.

Good to have

Familiarity with Python for scripting, automation, or testing.

Exposure to test automation frameworks.

Understanding of indexing, search, database internals, or storage systems.

Familiarity with multithreading, concurrency, and operating system fundamentals.

Experience using Git and a debugger such as GDB or Visual Studio.

Projects or internships demonstrating C++, SQL, debugging, automation, or thoughtful testing.

title: Software Engineer
text:
Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
About the team
We are the Workplace engineering pillar in ServiceNow’s CRM & Industry Workflows organisation, building Workplace Service Delivery and its integrations with CSM and FSM. AI is the new baseline for how we build: it changes how engineers work and what “done” means.
The role
You will build features across the stack, working AI-native: breaking tasks into small pieces, giving AI agents the context they need, and verifying everything you ship. You own the stories you take on from implementation to production, including their correctness. There is no separate QE team to hand off to.
You will work with moderate guidance from senior engineers, with more detailed direction on new areas.
What you get to do
Build and own your work
Turn well-defined requirements into working, tested features, and ask good questions when they are not well-defined.
Build features across the stack (UI, APIs, data model, integrations) and the AI layer (agents, prompts, tools, and the context they run on), with guidance from senior engineers. Learn the parts that are new to you as you go.
Explain your work clearly: write PR descriptions and short design notes that a reviewer can follow, and demo what you built in sprint reviews.
Use AI tools effectively
Use agentic coding tools as your default way of working: give them clear context, review output critically, and never ship code you can’t explain.
Use and improve the instruction files and documentation that help agents work well in our codebase.
Keep up with AI tools and techniques, and share what you learn with your team.
Own correctness, with no handoff
Write your own unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge cases and failure modes.
Follow your work through release and fix what breaks.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience building and shipping software, or an advanced degree, or equivalent work experience.
Strong in at least one programming language, with solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
Curiosity and willingness to learn new layers of the stack: front end, back end, data, integrations, and AI (agents, prompts, evaluation). You don’t need to know our technologies on day one, but you should pick up unfamiliar ones quickly, with AI tools as part of how you learn.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in real work, and the discipline to verify their output through tests and review.
An understanding of how LLMs behave (context, hallucination) and their risks.
Initiative, good judgment within established practices, and clear written and verbal communication.
Even better if you have
A project where you built something with LLMs, agents, or RAG.
Exposure to the ServiceNow platform.
Experience with enterprise or multi-tenant SaaS products.
